many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import numpy as np, json
G=load()
# Rule hypothesis: fill all background cells within Chebyshev-expanded box [r0-k .. r1+k] x [c0-k .. c1+k] where k = min distance from frame to grid edge in each direction (i.e., smallest gap to border). Verify.
def solve(Ig):
    g=np.array(Ig); H,W=g.shape
    vals,cnt=np.unique(g,return_counts=True)
    bg=int(vals[np.argmax(cnt)])
    nz=[(v,int(c)) for v,c in zip(vals.tolist(),cnt.tolist()) if v!=bg]
    inner,outer=nz[0][0],nz[-1][0]
    ys,xs=np.where(g==outer); r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
    k=min(r0, H-1-r1, c0, W-1-c1)
    out=g.copy()
    for r in range(max(0,r0-k),min(H,r1+k+1)):
        for c_ in range(max(0,c0-k),min(W,c1+k+1)):
            if g[r,c_]==0: out[r,c_]=inner
    return out.tolist()
ok=all(solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output']).tolist() for i in (1,2,3,4))
print("all demos match:", ok)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import numpy as np, json
def f(Ig,k):
    g=np.array(Ig); H,W=g.shape
    vals,cnt=np.unique(g,return_counts=True)
    bg=int(vals[np.argmax(cnt)])
    nz=[(v,int(c)) for v,c in zip(vals.tolist(),cnt.tolist()) if v!=bg]
    ic,oc=nz[1][0],nz[0][0]
    ys,xs=np.where(g==oc); r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
    yy,xx=np.where(g==ic)
    ih,iw=int(yy.max()-yy.min()+1),int(xx.max()-xx.min()+1)
    out=g.copy()
    for r in range(max(0,r0-k),min(H,r1+k+1)):
        for c_ in range(max(0,c0-k),min(W,c1+k+1)):
            if g[r,c_]==bg: out[r,c_]=ic
    return out
ks={1:2,2:1,3:2,4:3,5:1}
